trigger: operator reported the DGX Spark embedding host crashed and the model stopped serving

resume.condition: DGX Spark is healthy and the exact home embedding model serves a compatibility probe again
resume.behavior: resume isolated candidate database; do not drop or rebuild legacy gbrain

notes: The process was terminated after the operator reported the hardware crash; there was no normal CLI exit receipt.
Partial candidate state is not acceptance evidence and must pass the full build bookmark/freshness gates after resume.
